step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows an automated migration workflow. A Migration Team uses Slack to trigger actions and populate DynamoDB metadata. An EC2 instance acting as the Migration Factory coordinates operations by making API calls to App Discovery Service, CloudEndure, baking AMIs, sharing AMIs across accounts, and launching the target EC2 instance. On-premise servers send discovery metadata and replicate block data to an EC2 hot replica managed by CloudEndure.
